problem.passage:
Isosceles triangle ABC has apex angle A measuring 80°, and sides AB and AC are congruent, as shown in the figure.

What is the measure of each base angle, in degrees, of the isosceles triangle described?
problem.stimulus: Isosceles triangle ABC has apex angle A measuring 80°, and sides AB and AC are congruent, as shown in the figure.
problem.question: What is the measure of each base angle, in degrees, of the isosceles triangle described?
problem.explanationEn: The two base angles of an isosceles triangle are equal, so (180° − 80°) ÷ 2 = 50°.
